_comment: OPTIONAL per-site override sheet. Only needed when one codebase serves several
sites/locales that each need their own Marketo instance or Munchkin ID — otherwise
set the values inline in tools/marketo/marketo-config.js and delete this file.
This is the shape EDS serves for a published DA sheet: a `data` array of
{ key, value } rows. Author it as a two-column spreadsheet in DA (columns named
`key` and `value`), publish it, and point `sheet.path` in marketo-config.js at
Any key present here overrides the inline value; keys you omit fall through to
the inline config. Key names themselves are configurable under `sheet.keys`.
Delete this _comment field in a real sheet — it is here for documentation only.
